Same model K-454-4V-CP, polished chrome; listed in stock

writeup: Kohler's Memoirs Stately widespread bathroom faucet in polished chrome (K-454-4V-CP) is new on Woot for $333.99. It has solid brass construction, two Deco lever handles, ceramic disc UltraGlide valves and a pop-up drain, while Home Depot and SupplyHouse both charge $672.82. Woot showed only 1 left, with a 90-day Woot warranty.
